desc: Ideation: choose algorithm (three independent knapsacks + binary search on answer T, replacing the O(X²) merge)
Implement full solution: fast I/O + grouping by vitamin, vectorized 0/1 knapsack per group, monotone f_v, binary search feasibility via `np.searchsorted`, print answer (with numpy-less fallback)

Validate: samples reasoned through by hand (T=3 ⇒ 5+5+10=20 ≤ 25 feasible, T=4 ⇒ 30 > 25 infeasible ⇒ 3; empty vitamin-3 group ⇒ f₃ ≡ 0 ⇒ answer 0), plus edge cases (missing vitamin group, C_i > X filter, int64 overflow bound 10⁹)
Complexity check: O(N·X) = 25M vectorized numpy element-ops for the three knapsacks + ~30 binary-search iterations of 3 `searchsorted` calls — comfortable runtime margin
